name: order-tracker
title: Order tracker
description: Delivery progress as steps joined by a line that fills up to the current one. Horizontal on wide screens, vertical on phones.
htmlExample: <bef-order-tracker class="w-[40rem] max-w-full" :current="2" :steps='[{"label":"Ordered","time":"10 Oct, 9:12 am"},{"label":"Packed","time":"10 Oct, 6:40 pm"},{"label":"Shipped","description":"Pune hub","time":"11 Oct, 8:05 am"},{"label":"Out for delivery"},{"label":"Delivered"}]'></bef-order-tracker>
